title: Event storming plugin
summary: Skills for event storming and domain-driven design workshops.
benefit: Ready-made steps for running event storming and domain design sessions.
solves: Domain modeling workshops run without a method, or not run at all.
use_cases: "Run an EventStorming session": facilitation steps for Big Picture, Process and Design-Level workshops.
"Simulate a workshop": an AI-run session with several personas, for when the team is not in the room.
The skills load only when used.
details: Installs the event-storming plugin, which adds skills for event storming and domain-driven design workshops. It is for teams doing domain modeling or workshop-style design sessions. It comes from the third-party melodic-software/claude-code-plugins marketplace as skills that load only when used; if adding that marketplace from GitHub fails with a Windows rename error, use a local clone instead.
user_steps: If adding the marketplace from GitHub fails with a Windows EPERM rename error, make a local sparse clone of it and add that folder as a directory marketplace instead.
risk: Installed from a third-party marketplace; adds skills that load when used. Nothing is shipped here.
